description:
Promptbanken is an open, curated library of ready-to-use prompt templates, with a strong focus on Swedish municipalities, schools, public-sector organizations, and professionals. Browse templates, inspect individual prompts, and discover relevant prompt packages directly through ChatGPT.

The published connector provides read-only access to Promptbanken’s open catalog. No personal or confidential user data is sent to or stored by the Promptbanken server.

resources.description: Diagnostic only: check that Promptbanken is reachable and report the service status. Not part of normal use -- go straight to search_templates or recommend_packages for a user's task, and reach for this only when a call has failed and you need to know whether the service is up. Reads no prompt content and takes no input.

resources.description: Browse Promptbanken's catalogue of ready-made prompt templates for Swedish public-sector work -- writing, communication, decision support, leadership and more. The catalogue is open to everyone; no account or key is needed. Use search_templates when the task is known -- this tool is for browsing, and is paginated: it returns 25 summaries at a time, with total and has_more telling you whether to fetch the next page with offset. Call get_template(id) for the full text of a chosen template. Set include_prompt_text=true only when every prompt really is needed at once -- it will crowd out the conversation. context_keys picks the variant written for the user's setting, for example kommun or skola.

limit.description: How many templates to return on this page.

offset.description: Where to start. Use with has_more to page through.

include_prompt_text.description: Return the full prompt text of every template on the page. Off by default because it is large.

resources.name: Lista publicerade promptmallar

resources.description: Find the prompt templates that fit a task, without pulling in the whole catalogue. This is the normal way into the catalogue. PRIVACY: send only general, anonymised search terms that describe the kind of task -- never the user's own text, pasted document content, case material, personal data or confidential information. Summarise the need in a few words instead. The free-text query is matched against title, purpose, tags and output format; area and risk_level narrow the result. role ranks results toward a job function -- it does not hide templates from other areas. context_keys picks the variant written for the user's setting. Returns short summaries, so call get_template(id) on a chosen result for the full prompt.

query.description: General, anonymised search terms describing the kind of task -- never the user's own text, document content, personal data or confidential material.

role.description: Ranks results toward relevant job functions. Does not exclude templates from other areas.

area.description: Restrict the search to one area. The values are the package slugs in the published catalogue.

resources.name: Sök publicerade promptmallar

resources.description: Fetch one template in full, ready to use, by the id returned from search_templates or list_templates. context_keys only chooses which stored variant comes back. The template arrives as its own text plus the fields the user is meant to fill in; the client fills those in locally -- the server never returns a finished, filled-in prompt.
resources.name: Hämta en publicerad promptmall

resources.description: List Promptbanken's packages -- themed sets of prompts that carry a whole task from start to finish, such as change communication or preparing a decision. Returns just enough to choose one: slug, title, summary and type. Call get_package(slug) for the package's own introduction, and list_package_prompts(slug) for its steps. context_keys picks the variant written for the user's setting; package_type narrows the list when supplied.
resources.name: Lista publicerade promptpaket

resources.description: Fetch one package by its slug -- a short name such as 'kommunikation', not a template id -- in the variant that best matches context_keys. Returns the package's introduction plus the fields the client fills in locally; the server never returns finished text. Use list_package_prompts for the prompts inside the package.
resources.name: Hämta ett publicerat promptpaket

resources.description: List the steps inside one package, in the order they are meant to be used. Takes the package slug -- a short name such as 'kommunikation', not a template id -- and context_keys to pick the variant written for the user's setting. Returns each step's id, title and purpose; fetch a step's prompt text with get_template(id) when that step is actually reached. Set include_prompt_text=true only to pull every step's text at once.

include_prompt_text.description: Return every step's full prompt text. Off by default -- fetch the step you need with get_template(id) instead.

resources.name: Lista mallar i ett promptpaket

resources.description: Suggest which prompt packages suit a given job role -- a good first step when the user does not yet know what to ask for. Takes a short Swedish role term such as 'chef' or 'kommunikator'; ask the user for their role first if it is unknown. An unrecognised role returns every package with role_recognized=false rather than an empty result.
resources.name: Rekommendera promptpaket för en roll

release_notes:
1.2.2 — Privacy policy, tool metadata, and catalog fixes

This release responds to the 1.2.1 review, which asked for a complete privacy
policy reflecting current tool inputs and outputs.

Privacy
- A dedicated privacy policy for this connector, in English and Swedish. It
  covers only the open MCP surface: the exact tool parameters we receive, what
  is returned, what is stored and for how long, who receives it, and the
  controls available. The web service has its own separate policy, linked from
  it.
- The access log no longer records client IP addresses, ports, cookies, or
  authorization and API-key headers. Logs are deleted after at most 30 days.
- search_templates now states in its tool description, and on the query
  parameter itself, that only general anonymized search terms may be sent --
  never the user's own text, document content, personal data, or confidential
  material.

Tool metadata
- All nine tools now declare an output schema, so a client knows the shape of
  every response.
- All nine carry invocation status messages, which were empty in 1.2.1.
- Tool descriptions were rewritten to say what each tool is for, rather than
  naming internal payload fields.

Catalog fixes
- Search no longer returns the whole catalog for short queries. Two-letter
  terms such as AI, HR, and IT are now searchable, and short terms must match a
  whole word rather than letters inside another word.
- The area filter follows the published catalog instead of a hardcoded list, so
  all 17 areas can be filtered on.
- Responses are smaller and fetched just in time: list_templates is paginated,
  list_package_prompts returns the steps of a package and leaves each step's
  text to get_template, and list_packages returns what a listing needs.

No authentication is required. The connector remains strictly read-only and
publishes no write tools.

sv-SE.description:
Promptbanken är ett öppet, kurerat bibliotek med färdiga promptmallar, med särskilt fokus på svenska kommuner, skolor, offentlig sektor och yrkesverksamma. Bläddra bland mallar, granska enskilda prompts och hitta relevanta promptpaket direkt via ChatGPT.

Den publicerade anslutningen ger skrivskyddad åtkomst till Promptbankens öppna katalog. Inga personuppgifter eller konfidentiella användaruppgifter skickas till eller lagras på Promptbankens server.
sv-SE.subtitle: Hitta och använd promptmallar
